name: Claude Code
what: Anthropic's terminal coding agent. It talks to Anthropic's API, not to local servers, so it has no local bindings; it is listed for its version and its update.

detect.note: installed either by the native installer (~/.local/bin/claude) or as the npm package @anthropic-ai/claude-code

update.note: The native installer updates itself with `claude update`; an npm install uses npm-global with package @anthropic-ai/claude-code instead (override in the inventory).

all: Follow the installer at claude.com/claude-code, or: npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code

good: cloud-model coding sessions beside the local ones
not: anything that must stay on the machine: it is a cloud client
